content.short: AMM-based decentralized exchange for assets that are native to the Cardano Blockchain.
content.description:
A next-generation decentralised exchange for assets that are native to the Cardano Blockchain.

DOEX has amazing features that are set to bring exchange operations to the Cardano Community and take the DeFi ecosystem to the next level. These features form our core unique value proposition and with the help of next-generation focused technology, provides us with a strong competitive advantage, that is set to propel us ahead of our competition.

Some of DOEX’s outstanding features include multiple pricing functions for a single liquidity pool, trade routing, instant price feed via on-chain price oracle, and automatic babel fees redemption for Stake Pool Operations (SPOs) that is Cardano Blockchain-based.

Our vision is to become the first Cardano-based DEX, while ensuring interoperability across the chains and allowing for the seamless swap of tokens on the Cardano blockchain as well as other blockchains like Ethereum, all done via a fool-proof bridge or converter. This is part of our extended vision of laying a solid background for extended business and expansion opportunities.

Our long term objective is to be the one-stop-shop for DeFi services on the Cardano blockchain, including but not limited to staking and asset management.
